That look — it's not even about Mari, it's about them not knowing where to put you now. You'd be spending the afternoon managing their faces instead of eating tamales.

You don't have to buy the whole afternoon. Show up early, before the room fills, sit where your tía's chair is, and leave when you've had enough — nobody's owed an explanation for an early exit at a tamalada. Beto already knows, so he's not going to make it weird; he's the one who wants you there.

But if the look is the whole price of admission and you're not willing to pay it Saturday, that's allowed too. You can answer Beto honestly: "I'm not up for the whole room yet. Can I come by early before everyone shows?"
